# Lambris Training Award

We are grateful to the Lambris Family for their longstanding support of early-career researchers through the Lambris Training Award within ICS, and for extending this support to the ECN meeting at EMCHD2026 for the first time.

![](../images/lambris_award.jpg){fig-align="center"}

This award will be presented for the first time at **EMCHD 2026 in Cardiff**. The Lambris Complement Training Award aims to recognize and support an outstanding early-career researcher who shows exceptional promise in becoming a leading investigator in complement research. The award includes a **Certificate of Award** and a **honorarium of €2,500**.

To apply for the award, you must:

- Be registered for EMCHD 2026
- Have submitted an abstract
- Follow the guidelines available here: [https://www.ecomplement.org/activities/lambris-complement-training-award](https://www.ecomplement.org/activities/lambris-complement-training-award)
- Note that nominations may be suggested and submitted by any member of the ECN; self-applications are not accepted
- The nomination deadline is July 15, 2026. Please send your application to Mihály Józsi at [mihaly.jozsi@ttk.elte.hu](mailto:mihaly.jozsi@ttk.elte.hu).
